parameters.content:
## 02 Instagram DM Qualifier

Inbound Instagram DM to intent classification, one qualifying question, and a human handoff.

**Safety rails:** Calls 16-safety-rails before any outbound action.

**Before you enable this:** replace every REPLACE_WITH_* value, point CRM_BASE_URL/CRM_ADAPTER at your CRM, and run it once manually with test data.

Docs: README.md, docs/SETUP.md, docs/COMPLIANCE.md

nodes.name: IG DM Webhook
nodes.notes: Meta messaging webhook. Requires an approved app with instagram_manage_messages.

nodes.name: Safety Rails
nodes.notes: Calls 16-safety-rails. Nothing that can reach a prospect runs before the rails return allowed=true.

nodes.name: Rails Allowed?
nodes.notes: False branch is a dead end by design.

nodes.name: CRM Upsert
nodes.notes: One HTTP node, one mapping node. Swap CRM by changing CRM_BASE_URL, the credential and CRM_ADAPTER. See docs/CRM-MAPPING.md.

parameters.text: =Qualified IG DM from @{{ $json.lead.handle }}: {{ $json.lead.last_inbound_message }} - reply in the inbox, this workflow does not close deals.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ recipient: { id: $json.lead.handle }, message: { text: $env.IG_QUALIFY_QUESTION || 'Happy to help. What are you trying to get done, and by when?' } }) }}

nodes.name: Send Qualifying Question
nodes.notes: One question, then a human takes over. No drip from a DM webhook.

nodes.name: Ignore Non Lead
nodes.notes: Collab spam and noise stop here. Nothing is stored.
